in_marathi.name: Pappukumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu's servant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pappukumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pappukumar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'pappa' which means 'servant' and 'kumar' which means 'young boy'. This name is used to refer to Lord Vishnu's servant or a young boy who serves his lord or master.
